:::{#thm-bernoulli-hessian-contribution}
#### Hessian contribution of one binary outcome

If $\Outvar_\iobs \sim \Ber(\prob)$ has observed value $\outvar_\iobs \in \cb{0, 1}$,
its Hessian contribution is:

$$\hess_\iobs(\prob) = -\frac{\outvar_\iobs}{\sqf{\prob}} - \frac{1 - \outvar_\iobs}{\sqf{1 - \prob}}$$

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-bernoulli-hessian-contribution, worked in @sol-bernoulli-hessian-contribution.

:::
